name: io.github.lineai-intelligence/lineai-mcp-server
description: An MCP Server to utilize Lineai's rich software dependency data in your AI programming assistant.

environmentVariables.description: url to the Lineai server e.g. https://myco.app.lineai.net

environmentVariables.description: When enabled, additional debug files such as timing_log.txt and impact_data*.json will be generated. Defaults to false
environmentVariables.name: LINEAI_DEBUG_MODE
